findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice bin is observed with an accumulation of mold/soil build up on the baffles. PIC was made aware of this and immediately cleaned and sanitized these surfaces during today’s inspection. A covering of plastic was placed over the ice to protect it from any potential contamination during the cleaning and sanitizing process. After PIC completed the cleaning and sanitizing, these surfaces were re-observed in compliance and are being recorded as Corrected on Site.  
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: There is observed bare wood at the bar behind the triple sink and near the hand sink. The facility may paint, seal, place plexiglass, or place some sort of other material in these locations to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. C

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas are observed to have an accumulation of food debris or soil:
-The bottom shelf of the freezers have an accumulation of breading and other food debris that will need to be cleaned and have the debris removed.
-The fan in the kitchen is observed to have an accumulation of dust/soils. The cage of the fan needs to be cleaned and maintained clean in order to be used in the kitchen.
Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The beer glass cooler with the beer glasses stored mouth down in contact with the shelving is observed to have an accumulation of soil/mold on the shelving. These shelves need to have the beer glasses removed and have the shelving cleaned and sanitized. The cleaning and sanitizing process should take place at a frequency necessary to maintain the shelving clean. The glasses were removed from the shelf during the inspection and the shelf was cleaned and sanitized before placing the glasses back onto the shelf. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The chain of the lights and the conduit pipes along the wall in the kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The hand sink is observed to have pulled away front he wall slightly which has resulted in a gap between the sink and the wall. This area needs to be resealed to the wall by firmly reattaching the hand sink to the wall and then resealing the sink to the wall.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: During the inspection, there is no Certified Food Manager present. PIC has their food handlers, but not their CFM. Being a High Risk facility, it is required that a Certified Food Manager be present during all hours of operation. Ensure adequate staff are Certified to maintain the hours of operation.
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection, the sanitizer bucket did not have any sanitizer in it. During the inspection, sanitizer was added and the solution was measured at 150ppm QUAT sanitizer. Ensure test strips are utilized regularly to ensure the sanitizer bucket is at the adequate concentration during all hours of operation. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: The hand sink at the bar was observed to be blocked by an empty sanitizer bucket. This item was removed to allow the hand sink to be readily accessible. Ensure that the hand sink is used for hand washing only and remains accessible during all hours of operation.
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Food contact surfaces need to be clean to sight and touch. The nozzle of the soda gun in the bar area is observed with pink and brown substances in the holes. The situation was discussed with the  PIC. Inspector suggested using a flossing brush to clean the holes without damaging the equipment. The item was washed during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed the soda nozzle of the soda gun at the bar to be soiled with an accumulation of black friable material. Nozzle is reported to be soaked overnight. Nozzle will need to be scrubbed, washed, rinsed and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Soda nozzle of soda gun - food contact surface is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).
